bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 30cm x 40cm x 20cm are prohibited. Rucksacks and backpacks are not allowed, and there is no storage facility for prohibited items.
allowed: Bags up to 30cm wide x 20cm long x 20cm deep
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: On-site parking at Utilita Arena Sheffield often sells out in advance, so it's recommended to purchase parking tickets online beforehand for guaranteed reserved parking. Parking is for one admission only, and re-entry is not allowed.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Utilita Arena Sheffield's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Utilita Arena Sheffield offers a variety of food and drink options with a focus on fresh, tasty, and locally sourced products. Gluten-free and vegan options are available, and all outlets are cashless, accepting only card payments.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Utilita Arena Sheffield, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Utilita Arena Sheffield's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Utilita Arena Sheffield. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Utilita Arena Sheffield. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
